Players Committee card image of [[Acclamator-Class Assault Ship (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “May add 4 pilots, 4 passengers, and 4 vehicles. Adds 1 to attrition against opponent here for each piloted [Republic] starship present here. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Concussion Missiles may deploy aboard.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/acclamatorclassassaultship.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6d7b3a40f529171f7399cff382887d6260118998 6d7b3a4] (9 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
